summary: ```markdown # CLO Technique Teaching Mini-Class ## Sharing Techniques for Package Closure Production ### Introduction In this mini-class, we will explore various techniques for package closure production, focusing on the use of tools and parameters to achieve optimal results. ### Dimensions of the Long Square Plate The length of the long square plate is **10 mm**, and the height is **250 mm**. ### Creating a Knot To create a knot, we need to reduce the strength of the particle and check the thickness of the collision. The current thickness of the collision is **2.5 mm**. There is no need to adjust it further. 1. Use the **fixed needle tool** to fix the needles in each row. 2. During the simulation process, utilize the fixed needle tool to transform the rectangular plate into a circle and then proceed to make a knot. 3. While knotting, press the **W key** to add a fixed needle. 4. Press the **W key** again to click on the fixed needle. This action allows you to delete the fixed needle if necessary. ### Managing the Simulation In the process of knotting, it is important to pause the simulation. This will help us record the state of the simulation to prevent any unwanted alterations to the knotting process. ### Fabric Adjustment To adjust the fabric properties: 1. Place the fabric around the rope and adjust its size. 2. Change its fabric physics attribute to **default fabric simulation**. This step should be repeated for optimal results. ### Wrapping the Rectangular Board The rectangular board needs to be wrapped around the rope. To do this: 1. Set up **two internal lines**. 2. Use the **folding arrangement tool** to fold the board. 3. After folding, sew it together. ### Modifying the Structure Since the board is small, it is necessary to reduce the structure of the barrier. The following adjustments should be made: 1. Use the folding arrangement tool to fold again. 2. As the rope is a virtual model with a surface of **3 mm**, modify it to **0 mm**. 3. After this modification, delete the folding arrangement. ### Seam Line Adjustments Due to the diameter being wider, the board may slip. To address this: - Reduce the particle diameter to **1**. - There is a seam line mark on the seam side. If you wish to remove the mark, delete the seam line. ### Tightening and Adjusting Shape If the package is tightly packed, it can be divided into three boards. To tighten the structure: - Set different shrinkage values. - Adjust the shape of the plastic accordingly. ### Wheel Insertion Issue If the shape is too tight, inserting the wheel becomes difficult. - If the plate shape is overly tight, it will impede the wheel insertion. - Open the disc to observe its movement. - Direct it to the bottom and bend the wheel accordingly. ### Conclusion When moving the wheel toward the center, ensure it aligns with the actual center of the wheel from the initial position. The wheel should move smoothly into place, ensuring proper alignment. Thank you for participating in this mini-class! ```
